title.narrative: Output 1 Smallscale EE and RE solutions are promoted in lowincome rural or urban households and settlements.s

description.narrative: 1. A feasibility study on the cultivation of crops to serve both agriculture and energy purposes has been conducted and completed by the Armenian National Agrarian University. Four varieties of crops have been suggested for cultivation to serve both agriculture and energy purposes. The summary workshop with a presentation of the study results was organized in July 2023 with participation of more than 30 representatives of the partner Ministries, international community, academic and nongovernmental institutions as well as business representatives. The study report is available at: https://biodiverssouthcaucasus.org/uploads/files/Feasibility%20fodder,%20energy%20%20ENG.pdf.2. An assessment and improvement of energy efficiency of locally produced onepoint stoves and local heating boilers working on solid biomass fuel has been initiated. Two models of stoves and 5 models of boilers have been assessed according to the applicable standards and available technical capacities, the works on improvement of the stoves and 2 models of boilers are in the process. A technical workshop to present and discuss the methodology and approaches was organized in June with the presence of more than 20 representatives of the partner ministries, academicscientific institutions, international organizations, the nongovernmental sector, and others. The initially improved models of stoves are available. The improved models of stoves will be promoted in 5 target marzes to households with a focus on the forcibly displaced families from Nagorno Karabakh and other socially vulnerable families.direct support embedded in them

description.narrative: The overall objective of the EU Action Document EU4 Energy Efficiency and Environment is to improve energy efficiency and enhance environmental protection and resilience. The MultiDonor Action contributes to the achievement of the Specific Objective 1 of the EU Action Document: Establish enabling environment to promote energy efficiency in residential and public buildings, with particular focus on lowincome households and multiapartment residential buildings (MABs) and ensure effective oversight and monitoring.This MultiDonor Action has the following outputs: Output 1: Smallscale EE and RE solutions for lowincome rural or urban households and settlements are promoted through costsharing, awarenessraising and capacity building.Output 2: Investments in EE and RE demonstration pilots with high impact on a large proportion of the local population in predominantly energypoor communities are supported.These two outputs are mutually interlinked and highly complementary to each other. Promoting EE and RE solutions on household and community level (Outputs 1 and 2) contributes to reducing pressure on natural resources like the use of firewood or dung for heating, which leads to deforestation and degradation of land through erosion and lack of natural fertilizer. Improving access of households and communities to sustainable and affordable renewable energy supports social and economic development, thus, in its turn, contributing to sustainable management of natural resources. EE/RE demonstration pilots can serve as examples for further replication.This intervention contributes to the Agenda 2030, primarily to the achievement of SDG 7 (Access to sustainable and affordable energy) and to SDG 11 (Sustainable cities and communities) and to SDG 13 (Climate protection). It also supports achieving SDG 1 (Poverty reduction) as well as SDG 15 (Life on land) and takes account of interactions between the various dimensions and/or SDG subtargets.
